title: Pre-Game Stretch Flow (Michelle Grogan)
style: afrobeat-funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 128bpm djembe kora marimba slap bass sax horns dembow guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Warm it up warm it up before the game
Dynamic motion never the same
Warm it up warm it up easy lift
Ready the body for the gift

[Verse 1]
Leg swings ten and ten across the line
Knee circles ten ten time after time
Hip openers ten through the wide gate
Calf raises twelve then we accelerate
Vamos warming up the chain
Mobility before the pain
Spine roll spine roll five each way
Ready ready the body ready to play

[Pre-Chorus]
Warm it up warm it up
Fill the energy cup
Warm it up warm it up
Every joint is up

[Chorus]
Pre-game stretch flow before the first ball
Dynamic mobility wakes up the call
Pre-game stretch flow ten reps each
Pre-game stretch flow ready to teach
Vamos vamos pa lante
Warm it up
Vamos vamos pa lante
Ready to play up

[Verse 2]
Arm circles forward ten then back
Wrist rolls slow loosen the rack
Neck side to side gentle five times
Shoulder rolls ten loosens the rhymes
Uno dos tres four five six
Seven eight nine ten in the mix
Light jog around the court two laps
High knees and butt kicks claps and snaps

[Bridge]
Fifteen minutes is the warm up rule
Dynamic not static stay cool
Never stretch cold its the law
Movement movement loosen the draw

[Chorus]
Pre-game stretch flow before the first ball
Dynamic mobility wakes up the call
Pre-game stretch flow ten reps each
Pre-game stretch flow ready to teach

[Outro]
Warm it up warm it up before the game
Dynamic motion never the same
Warm it up warm it up easy lift
Ready the body for the gift
